hookups.source: https://www.jekyllisland.com/lodging/jekyll-island-campground/ ('216 full hook-up sites', 'Electricity (30 & 50 amps), water, and sewer available'; full hook-up 'Includes water, power, and sewer'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 228 campsites: 216 full-hookup (back-in and pull-through), 12 primitive tent sites with water only, and six yurts. Maximum RV length 45 ft, with a per-site limit shown when booking. Smaller self-contained RVs and camper vans may use a primitive site, depending on size; no tow-behinds there.

sites.source: https://www.jekyllisland.com/lodging/jekyll-island-campground/ (site counts, 'The maximum RV length is 45 feet, depending on site availability', 'Pull-through sites from $54/day', primitive-site FAQ), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Two bathhouses with toilets and hot showers; card-operated laundry; general store with RV supplies, propane, firewood and groceries; bike rentals. No pool.

facilities.source: https://www.jekyllisland.com/lodging/jekyll-island-campground/ (Amenities list; 'does not have an on-site pool facility'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Booking and fees (manual, 2026-09-20) agree with the page: 3-night holiday minimum, 14-night max, back-in from $51, pull-through $54, tent $36, $25 cancellation. Added 30/50-amp full hookups, 216 RV sites to 45 ft with pull-throughs, showers/laundry/store. Not stated: season.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead (contrary claim): stored 'coastal woods', but the operator FAQ says 'Our campsites are nestled underneath the tree canopy of the maritime forest ... about a half-mile from Driftwood Beach. There are no waterfront campsites.' The --AWH note also gives a half-mile walk to the beach. Check whether the ~800 m between the loops and the shore is the campground's own undeveloped forest (coastal woods) or other land use (Clam Creek picnic area, roads).
Phone field reads 916-635-3021; the campground page gives 912-635-3021 (912.635.3021). Looks like a typo in the stored phone.

Fees base (manual, not changed): nightly_low $36 is the primitive TENT site price; the cheapest RV site is the $51 full-hookup back-in. The page does allow small self-contained RVs/camper vans in primitive sites 'depending on size', so $36 may stand, but for a 23-ft motorhome the RV base is $51.
